title: Vercel Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs and What Changed

facts.fact: Vercel's page lists v0 Plus at $30 per user per month, shown struck through from $90.
facts.quote: $30 (shown struck from $90) | per user per month

facts.fact: Vercel's page lists v0 Business at $100 per user per month, with $30 monthly credits and $2 daily credits plus team features.
facts.quote: **Business** | $100 | per user per month | $30 monthly credits + $2 daily credits; team features

facts.fact: Vercel's page lists the Pro platform plan at $20 per deploying seat per month, including $20 of usage credit and free viewer seats.
facts.unit: USD per deploying seat per month
facts.quote: **Pro** | $20 | per deploying seat per month | $20 included usage credit; free viewer seats

facts.fact: Vercel's Flat Rate CDN tiers are listed at $20 per month for 10M requests/50 TB, $100 for 50M requests, and $300 for 150M requests.
Vercel's published Active CPU usage rate starts at $0.128 per hour.
facts.quote: Active CPU from $0.128/hour

facts.fact: Vercel's published function invocation rate is $0.60 per 1 million invocations.
facts.quote: function invocations $0.60 per 1M

facts.fact: Vercel's published AI Gateway rate is $3 per 1,000 token requests.
facts.quote: AI Gateway $3 per 1,000 token requests

facts.fact: Vercel's published trigger rate is $0.95 per 1,000 triggers.
facts.quote: triggers $0.95 per 1,000

facts.fact: Vercel's on-demand CDN is listed from $0.15 per GB and $2 per 1 million requests.
facts.quote: On-demand CDN from $0.15/GB and $2 per 1M requests.

facts.fact: v0 model rates are listed as $0.20 input and $1.20 output per 1M tokens for v0 Mini.
facts.quote: v0 Mini $0.20 in / $1.20 out

facts.fact: v0 model rates are listed as $2 input and $10 output per 1M tokens for v0 Pro.
v0 model rates are listed as $5 input and $25 output per 1M tokens for v0 Max.
v0 model rates are listed as $10 input and $50 output per 1M tokens for v0 Max Fast.
facts.quote: v0 Max Fast $10 / $50

facts.fact: Vercel's free tier for v0 gives new users a one-time $5 credit and 7 messages per day.
facts.quote: Free: $5 one-time credits for new users, 7 messages/day.

facts.fact: Vercel's Hobby free plan (non-commercial) includes 100 GB transfer, 1M edge requests, 4 hours of Active CPU, and 500 AI Gateway requests.
facts.quote: Hobby: free (non-commercial), 100 GB transfer, 1M edge requests, 4 hours Active CPU, 500 AI Gateway requests.

facts.fact: Vercel's Pro plan was restructured in September 2025 to a $20 platform fee with one deploying seat and $20 usage credit.
facts.quote: Sep 2025: Pro restructured to a $20 platform fee with one deploying seat and $20 usage credit; free viewer seats.

facts.fact: Vercel states Flat Rate CDN became generally available on 8 September 2026 and is the default for new Pro teams.
facts.quote: 8 Sep 2026: Flat Rate CDN generally available, default for new Pro teams, after customers asked for predictable bills.

facts.fact: Vercel's v0 Plus plan includes $30 monthly credits and $2 daily login credits.
facts.quote: $30 monthly credits + $2 daily login credits

facts.fact: Vercel's Pro plan includes a $20 monthly usage credit that applies across resources, with pay-as-you-go usage uncapped beyond it.
facts.quote: $20 monthly credit applies across resources; pay as you go uncapped beyond it.

facts.fact: Vercel's v0 additional credits can be purchased and shared across a team.
facts.quote: Additional credits can be purchased and shared across a team.

facts.fact: The site offers a free 30-minute Subscription Profit Review with a BPAG Accountants adviser to Australian businesses.
facts.quote: Yes, I'd like a **free 30-minute Subscription Profit Review** with a BPAG Accountants adviser (Australian businesses).

facts.fact: Australian business owners can get the hardcover of The Subscription Playbook free, shipped free.
facts.quote: Australian business owners get the hardcover free, shipped free.

facts.fact: The AI Pricing Index covers how 70+ AI and SaaS companies price, checked in October 2026.
facts.quote: How 70+ AI and SaaS companies price, checked October 2026.

facts.fact: The 'How to Price an AI Product' guide includes current price points from 40+ AI companies.
facts.quote: the six pricing models, real token costs, a worked margin example and current price points from 40+ AI companies.

facts.fact: The 'How to Price an AI Product' guide describes six pricing models.
facts.quote: How to price an AI product in 2026: the six pricing models, real token costs, a worked margin example
